subject: general
question: In July 2020, Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the new Supreme Court Building of _____ which was completed with Indian assistance
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mauritius.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Together, Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Prime Minister of** Mauritius, Mr. Pravind Jugnauth, started the new Supreme Court Building.
 
• The building is the first India-helped infrastructure project inside the **capital city of Port Louis** to be inaugurated** after the COVID pandemic.**
 
• There are **ten district courts on the island of Mauritius and one in Rodrigues**.
 
• Mauritius has a** single-structured judicial system** made up of two levels:** the Supreme Court and subordinate courts.**
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ff36e2af14fa0e82ee04aad1ab5ff9c50f8791d1d8ef8962a624e19df20316c.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The court system in **Afghanistan** is composed of the **Supreme Court, Courts of Appeal, and Primary Courts** (Article 116, the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Afghanistan, 2004).
 
• The **Maldives** keeps a **three-tier court system**: Supreme Court, High Court, and lower Courts. 
 
• The** Bhutanese** legal system has a **four-tier court system**, Supreme Court, the High Court, the Dzongkhag Courts, the Dungkhag Courts.​
